About Me

Researcher. Educator. Innovator.

A transportation safety researcher with a passion for applying machine learning and computer vision to save lives on winter roadways.

Professional Background

I am a transportation safety researcher and lecturer at the University of Wyoming's Department of Civil & Architectural Engineering and Construction Management. My work spans traffic safety, crash analysis, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), and AI-driven computer vision for adverse weather conditions.

Before joining UW, I spent nearly a decade as a Research Engineer at King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM) in Saudi Arabia, where I conducted applied research in traffic simulation, safety analysis, and transportation data analytics.

Research Focus

My doctoral dissertation, "Integrated Framework for Snowplow Truck Safety Through Machine Learning, Spatial Analysis, and Vision-Based Collision Avoidance in Snowy Conditions," developed collision warning and avoidance systems using LiDAR, thermal cameras, and deep learning models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN) deployed on NVIDIA Jetson Orin hardware — directly applied by the Wyoming DOT.

Research Areas

Advancing Transportation Safety

My research tackles real-world safety challenges on winter roadways through an interdisciplinary blend of AI, spatial analysis, and crash modeling.

❄

Snowplow Safety & Collision Avoidance

Developing and deploying collision warning systems for WYDOT snowplow trucks using sensor fusion — LiDAR, thermal cameras, and RGB video — with deep learning models for adverse-weather vehicle detection.

📊

Crash Analysis & Spatial Modeling

Applying Kernel Density Estimation, Moran's Index, and Bayesian Binary Logit Models to identify crash hotspots and understand injury severity along Wyoming's mountainous road networks.

🤖

Computer Vision for ITS

Training and deploying Faster R-CNN and YOLO models for real-time vehicle detection under heavy snowfall, enabling autonomous no-passing zone detection on two-lane highways.

🌐

Traffic Simulation & Calibration

Calibrating PARAMICS and VISSIM microsimulation models using AI-based neuro-fuzzy approaches, with application to traffic flow studies across Saudi Arabia and Wyoming.

🛠

Machine Learning for Crash Severity

Leveraging Random Forest, LightGBM, and XGBoost pipelines with ADASYN, BORUTA, Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, and SHAP explainability for 4-class crash severity prediction.

🌀

Autonomous Vehicles & Urban Mobility

Assessing AV impacts on traffic flow, greenhouse gas emissions, and COVID-era urban mobility transformation; exploring active transportation solutions for congested cities including Dhaka.
